# inference-data

Sourced LLM inference measurements. CSV (UTF-8, comma, dot decimal) is canonical. Empty cell = unknown. Do not invent values.

Tables, joined by string ids: data/sources.csv, data/hardware.csv, data/models.csv, data/measurements.csv.
Contract: datapackage.json (Frictionless). Same rows as JSON: data/json/.

measurements.csv columns: measurement_id, hardware_id, hw_count, model_id, quantization, engine, engine_version, context_tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens, concurrency, prefill_tok_s, decode_tok_s, decode_tok_s_per_user, ttft_ms, power_w, task_time_s, source_id, evidence, notes.

evidence: measured_by_source | vendor_claim | unverified_claim | derived.
derived = formula on a spec (bandwidth / 70 GB, dense TFLOPS / (2 * 70e9 params)), not a timer.
decode_tok_s is aggregate tok/s. decode_tok_s_per_user only if the source printed it.

Every measurement needs a source row with an https URL and date_accessed (YYYY-MM-DD). source_type: benchmark, vendor, video, post.

Python: pandas.read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knoel99/inference-data/main/data/measurements.csv")
or: from inference_data import load; load()

Add a row: new source if needed, reuse hardware_id and model_id, one measurement row, notes for anything left blank, then python scripts/validate.py.
Data license CC-BY-4.0. Code license MIT.
See README.md and AGENTS.md.
